verdict.rationale: Square is a payments/SaaS platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. First-party developer docs have a dedicated 'Square Model Context Protocol Server' page, and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at developer.squareup.com/docs/mcp. The evidence is limited to the page title and that probe, so it shows the server exists but says nothing about how it works. Missing for 10: documented tool/API coverage exposed via MCP, auth/OAuth and transport details (hosted vs local), client setup instructions, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://developer.squareup.com/docs/mcp
